summary: Read all 14 pages' frontmatter and the passages naming each target, plus the target pages where they could carry the reason. All 27 weak links carry a verdict: 16 label, 7 retype, 4 cut, 0 keep-as-is (none were already labelled). The pattern: most bare links had a real sentence on the source page (Lens sections, Cross-Domain Resonance, dispatch paragraphs) and only needed a name for the register; the retypes are mirrors (Whitehead x2, Stoicism-Palace Map, Confucianism-Symbiotic Skills), contradicts (Drift-Entry Conatus), emerged-from (Confucianism from the Fire at Nicopolis) and exemplifies (VCV of the Registry Pattern). Cuts are Embeddings (MoE), Retrospective Delay (Sample Libraries), Web Audio Worklet (VCV, reason is only a TODO on the Worklet), and Palace To-Do (BBS, a stale claim). Not settled: the Symbiotic Skills/MoE and Excellent Adventure/Confucianism pairs each hold a reciprocal bare link outside this room that should be cut so the pair holds one; the Whitehead target STIGMERGY v1.0 is an archived page; Mixture of Experts to Boundary-Crossing Instruments is a thin example-only reason (low confidence). No new-entry inbound links proposed: the nine newcomers either already appear on these pages (CHILD, SCHEMA - Reference in Excellent Adventure and the Post-producer) or no genuine connection surfaced.
